content.description: Iteration 3: keep it02_s00 (best, S 1.047) and change only the levers its feedback isolates: sidewalk probability up (M10a), red-running push without swarm over-dispersion (M3), earlier-start probability up (M2), box params of it02_s03 with longer release lag (M7a).

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car (0.70 s vs 0.39 s in it02_s00, best of it02) and M5/length: unchanged short tau/minGap/low sigma keep the discharge headway low; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.
M1/car: a minority with tau 0.5 pulls mean car headway toward 0.39 s; no red-running attributes so M3/share/car stays low.

M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4): impatience 0.7 with a longer jmDriveAfterRedTime 7 s and jmDriveRedSpeed 8 m/s lets more riders enter on red; tau/minGap/lateral settings kept for M1/moto and M4 as in it02_s00.
M6/approach moto and M4/lat_moto (7.19 vs 7.085, close): small 5% slow group kept unchanged; larger shares lengthened approach times in it01.
M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27) and M9a (0.34 vs 0.33, already on target): the 10% seeker share that gave M9a on target is kept; red-running attributes raised like moto_std for M3.
M7a/release_time (-11.9 s in it02_s00, 0.62 s in it02_s03 vs 2.59 s) and M7b/clear_lag (5.1 vs 6.65 s): the it02_s03 box parameters gave the sane non-negative release time and are reused.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto (0.025 vs 0.13): 152 of 265 attempts ended before crossing and only p was limiting; raising p to 0.8 with the full 10 s window and v_max 5 m/s increases crossings before green; cars excluded (M2/early/car ~0.001).

M3/share/moto (0.038 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (1.6 vs 4.4) need a higher base rate p0 0.35; M3/var_to_mean (3.1 vs 1.31) is too clustered, so k drops from 0.1 to 0.03 to reduce follower-driven bursts.

M10a/per_cycle (0.03 vs 0.27): p_sidewalk raised from 0.06 to 0.2 and trigger lowered to 12 m (observed choice queue 12.7 m, M10b); p_right_lane stays 0.01 so M9a (0.34 vs 0.33) and M9b/share_blocked do not worsen; p_wrong_lane 0 as it is inapplicable on this net (R27).

M7a/release_time (0.6 s vs 2.59 s with a 2 s lag) and M7c/slope (0.18 vs 0.33 s/veh): a slightly longer extra hold of 2.5 s delays box exit after the opposing green end; M7b/clear_lag (5.1 vs 6.65 s) also moves up.
Behaviour 10 / M6 approach moto: slow riders hold the lane centre; unchanged since M4/lat_moto is near target.

reasoning: Start from best it02 spec (s00); adjust sidewalk, red-running (lower k for var/mean), early-start p, box lag; keep shares summing to 1 per distribution.
